articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: T-Mobile Restructuring For AI Future Raises Questions On Value And Earnings. T-Mobile US has begun a broad restructuring under new CEO Srini Gopalan, centered on digital transformation and AI-driven initiatives. The company is reducing headcount across retail, support, IT, and sales as part of a multi year plan aimed at reshaping operations. Management has outlined a goal of saving $3b by 2027 through expanded use of technology, particularly AI and digital platforms.
